bugs.text: startChallengingStage is redefined to call itself; on reaching stage 3 the game throws a stack-overflow RangeError every 2 s and stays on the STAGE 3 screen forever (soft-lock).
Rescuing a captured fighter sets state 'freed', which nothing handles; player.dual is never set true, and the freed object counts as alive, so the stage can never be cleared after a rescue.

Source of all 4 console errors: playerHit() reassigns enemyBullets=[] inside the reverse loop over enemyBullets; the next iteration reads undefined.y (692). The update step aborts for that frame; play continues.
High score is never updated and never written to localStorage.
Stage badges are six constant boxes, independent of the stage.
'STAGE 1' is never shown: startNewGame jumps straight into PLAYING.
P sets state to undefined (GameState.PAUSED does not exist); the screen goes blank with no PAUSED text.
No enemy-body collision with the player; ramming does nothing.
The captured fighter is left at the capture point mid-screen and drawn as a green Boss sprite plus a red box; it never sits above the Boss in formation.
Divers snap to their slot once below the screen instead of re-entering from the top.
Extra ships at 20,000 and 70,000 only, not every 70,000 after.
Formation sway/breath offset is applied at render time only (and to divers too), so hit tests use positions up to 8 px away from where enemies are drawn.
Wing animation only runs while entering or diving; formation enemies are static.
Goei escorts score 80 (formation) rather than 160 when shot during a dive.
Challenging stage (if it were reachable): player shots never move because updateBullets is not called, and every wave pays the 1,000 bonus because fly-through also marks enemies !alive.

summary: The file is complete and the skeleton is sound: a proper fixed-timestep loop, separate update and render paths, a correct 40-enemy formation, grouped Bezier entry flights, curved dives with escorts and fire, a working HUD and hit-results screen. But it was clearly not run: an abandoned formation block and a duplicated function were left in, the duplicate makes stage 3 recurse forever, every death from a bullet throws a TypeError, the pause state does not exist, the high score is never saved, and the signature mechanic is a shell. The tractor beam draws a cone while the Boss keeps diving, capture leaves a green Boss sprite floating mid-screen, and rescue produces a 'freed' object nobody updates while the dual fighter can never form. Stages 1 and 2 feel like a crude Galaga with rectangle sprites, static formation wings and circle explosions; nothing past stage 2 is reachable.
